subject: Confirmation: No-Training on Customer Data & Data Controls — Sequoia Health
messages:
From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>
To: Daniel Park <daniel.park@sequoiahealth.com>, Lara Nguyen <lara.nguyen@sequoiahealth.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Mar 2026 15:08:00 -0700
Subject: Confirmation: No-Training on Customer Data & Data Controls — Sequoia Health

Hi Daniel / Lara —

Thanks again for taking the call today. Quick recap and the concrete next steps from our side so we can get this into procurement: 

Key commitments we discussed: 
- Redwood will not use Sequoia Health customer data to train or improve public models. This no-training commitment will be recorded in the contract addendum (attached).
- For hosted deployments, we will enable request-level logging with PII redaction configurable by your team. Logs retained by default for 30 days; retention can be shortened per your policy or forwarded to your SIEM via syslog.
- Data residency: production artifacts for this deployment will live in our us-east-1 region (we can add eu-west-1 if required).

Outstanding items from Sequoia we need to finalize: 
1) Confirmation on the final retention window you'd like for logs (default 30 days, options: 7 / 30 / 90).
2) Whether you want Redwood to surface raw request/response payloads to your security team or only structured telemetry.
3) A sign-off on the "No-Training Addendum" language so we can append it to the DPA.

Next steps (from Redwood):
- I attached a draft No-Training Addendum and a redline DPA for your legal review.
- Aditya will prepare the SOW and committed capacity pricing after we confirm the above.
- Monica will schedule a short onboarding demo once contracts are complete.

If you can reply with answers to (1)-(3) by early next week we’ll circulate the final docs and a DocuSign link. Happy to jump on a 20-minute call to walk through any redline items.

Thanks,

Camila Reyes
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com | (415) 555-0198

Attachment: Sequoia_No_Training_Addendum.pdf (PDF, 2 pages)
Attachment: Redwood_DPA_2026-03-23-redline.docx (Word, redline)

From: Daniel Park <daniel.park@sequoiahealth.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Lara Nguyen <lara.nguyen@sequoiahealth.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 23 Mar 2026 09:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Confirmation: No-Training on Customer Data & Data Controls — Sequoia Health

Camila — thanks for the summary. Lara and I reviewed the draft addendum and the redline DPA. A few clarifications from our side: 

- Great to have the explicit no-training clause. Can you add language that also prevents transfer of derivative models trained on aggregated views that might contain our data? We want to avoid indirect incorporation.
- For logs: we prefer a 7-day retention on payloads that include any PII. For telemetry/structured metrics, 90 days is fine.
- On logging access, we only want structured telemetry to be viewable in the Redwood Console. Raw request/response payloads should be stored in an encrypted S3 bucket with access restricted to our security team via IAM role; Redwood should not access raw payloads unless explicitly approved for incident response.

Two procedural asks: 
1) Could you supply the exact syslog endpoint and auth mechanism that Redwood will use if we route logs to our SIEM?
2) We typically require a signature from our procurement lead. Please send the final addendum and DPA as a single DocuSign package.

If you can incorporate the derivative-model language and confirm the log retention + access controls, I'll escalate to procurement this afternoon.

Best,
Daniel

---
On Mon, Mar 23, 2026 at 08:05 AM Lara Nguyen <lara.nguyen@sequoiahealth.com> wrote:
> Thanks Camila — a couple of redline comments from legal included in the attached DPA.
> Lara

From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>
To: Daniel Park <daniel.park@sequoiahealth.com>, Lara Nguyen <lara.nguyen@sequoiahealth.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Mar 2026 10:31:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Confirmation: No-Training on Customer Data & Data Controls — Sequoia Health

Thanks Daniel — really helpful, and totally understandable asks. Quick responses inline and proposed changes: 

- Derivative models: we will add explicit language to the addendum that Redwood and its affiliates will not incorporate Sequoia Health data, or derivatives thereof, into model weights, training corpora, or shared optimization artifacts. That includes aggregated views that could be used to train other models.

- Retention: set as requested — 7 days for payloads containing PII; 90 days for telemetry/metrics. We will implement an automated purge for payloads at the 7-day mark.

- Access to raw payloads: Redwood will by default redact PII and not surface raw payloads in the Console. If Sequoia elects to route raw payloads to an encrypted S3 bucket in your AWS account, Redwood will not access those payloads except under a documented incident response procedure that requires: (a) written approval from your security contact, and (b) an audit entry logged to the tenant audit trail. We'll add that exact process text into the DPA addendum.

- Syslog endpoint / auth: Aditya has the syslog agent details and will include the supported TLS cert types and HMAC-based auth options in the follow-up.

Next steps: 
1) I'll update the addendum to include the derivative-model and access wording, then attach the consolidated DPA + addendum.
2) Aditya will send a short note with the syslog/auth specifics for your security team.
3) Once you confirm, we will package the DPA + addendum into DocuSign and share the link.

We'll aim to have the consolidated package by end of day today. Moving to procurement as soon as we have your confirmation.

Thanks — Camila

Camila Reyes
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com | (415) 555-0198

Attachment: Sequoia_No_Training_Addendum_v2.pdf (PDF, 2 pages)

From: Lara Nguyen <lara.nguyen@sequoiahealth.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>, Daniel Park <daniel.park@sequoiahealth.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Mar 2026 11:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Confirmation: No-Training on Customer Data & Data Controls — Sequoia Health

Camila / team — appreciate the rapid turn. The added derivative-model clause looks good to us in principle. We have one minor edit to propose on the incident response access window (requesting a 48-hour notification window before Redwood accesses any raw payloads), but that is procedural and okay to handle in DocuSign.

Please send the consolidated package via DocuSign and include the DocuSign PowerForm ID or link in the email thread. Once I have the signed package I will route to procurement.

Lara Nguyen
Associate General Counsel | Sequoia Health
lara.nguyen@sequoiahealth.com
